tools.name: travel_search
tools.description: Find real mock flight options for a one-way economy trip, one adult. Returns exact offerId values and does not reserve.

tools.name: travel_prepare
tools.description: Prepare a review from a returned offerId and traveler name. This does not book. The traveler must confirm it in the browser. Above $1,000 USD manager approval is separate.

tools.name: travel_book
tools.description: Submit exactly one prepared booking only after the gateway sends its exact browser-confirmed requestId. Payment remains pending; no ticket is issued. Never retry an uncertain result.

tools.name: travel_order
tools.description: Read back this conversation's existing known reservation. This cannot create a booking or make a payment.
